executiveSummary: Threat activity this period is elevated for critical infrastructure due to concurrent, actively exploited edge-access vulnerabilities and direct OT targeting. Active targeting of Siemens S7 PLCs across multiple U.S. sectors, including Water and Wastewater, using AI-assisted scripts over S7comm (TCP/102), warrants immediate network isolation, monitoring, and credential hardening. Security Advisory Industrial gateways widely used in utilities are affected by unauthenticated remote command execution and management-plane flaws: Advantech WISE-6610 (public exploits) and Advantech EKI-1242EIMS/IEIMS (critical missing-auth and RCE). CISA Weekly CISA Weekly Perimeter appliances are under active exploitation: NetScaler ADC/Gateway multiple RCEs and KEV-listed memory issue; F5 BIG-IP APM OAuth path RCE; Fortinet FortiMail path traversal-all enabling initial access and potential pivot toward OT. JPCERT Alert CISA KEV JPCERT Alert CISA KEV Enterprise identity and email infrastructure are at risk: mass exploitation of Oracle PeopleSoft (CVE-2026-35273) including a U.S. government portal; active pre-auth RCE on Cisco Secure Email Gateway. Investigative Report JPCERT Alert OT-specific advisories: Hitachi Energy REB500 (IEC 61850 DoS/memory corruption), Hitachi Energy Asset Suite unauth servlet access, and Johnson Controls EasyIO FG (EOL) hard-coded credentials elevate substation and building automation risk if not isolated. CISA ICS CISA ICS CISA ICS Campaign activity includes telecom-appliance backdoors in KR/TW and abuse of legitimate RMM (Action1) and web-delivered VBScript "ClickFix" chains-raising lateral movement risk into OT-adjacent zones. descriptions: Initial Access: Exploitation of public-facing applications and edge devices (NetScaler, F5 APM, FortiMail, Cisco SEG) [ATT&CK T1190]
Execution/Persistence: RMM abuse (Action1), scheduled tasks, LaunchAgents/ZSHRC tampering (macOS), OAuth endpoint exploitation
Privilege Escalation/Credential Access: AD misconfigurations (MAQ abuse), ADCS ESC1, DCSync, kerberoasting/SPN abuse [T1558/T1003]
Lateral Movement: VPN/SSO pivoting, appliance backdoors with proxy/tunneling capabilities, OT DMZ jump host targeting
Command and Control: SMTP C2, HTTPS-wrapped magic packets, STUN-masqueraded traffic, Solana-hosted C2 resolution
Impact: Domain-wide GPO manipulation to disable firewalls and distribute payloads; potential unsafe OT setpoint changes (S7comm writes)

outlook72h: Expect continued exploitation against exposed NetScaler/F5/FortiMail/Cisco SEG. Prioritize emergency patch windows and compromise assessments on all edge appliances. Increase monitoring on TCP/102 (S7comm) and engineering workstations for snap7 usage; validate PLC protections and remove any residual internet exposure. Hunt for new or unsanctioned RMM agents and scheduled tasks; educate users on BitB and "run this command" lures tied to ClickFix-style campaigns. Utilities using Advantech WISE-6610 or EKI-1242EIMS/IEIMS: isolate gateways immediately; review for unauthorized resets, config changes, and suspicious OPC UA sessions.
